notes.title: Version 2.0 - Now broadcasting!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a game-changing update to Chronicles of 2 Heroes. Since its launch in May 2023, the game has gotten a few minor updates. but now, the team is excited to announce a major update that's set to elevate your experience to epic new levels. 

[previewyoutube=MiGr3JAJmo8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










This new patch brings a series of improvements to graphics, gameplay, and level design! Thanks to your feedback, we have worked hard to enhance the gaming experience to make it even more engaging and enjoyable. Here’s what’s new: 
 
GRAPHICS

 Changed all parallax backgrounds to improve visual depth.
 Updated all tilesets for a more detailed and cohesive look.
 Added new background and foreground elements for all levels, further enriching the game environment.
 New particles added for levels: Izumo Forest, Mount Dogo, Osaka, Kozuki Graveyard, Daisen Sanctuary.
 Added new graphic element to visualize the switch power up state.

GAMEPLAY 

 Changed switch mechanics: now, when you switch characters, you enter an enhanced form for a limited time: the switch power up state. In this state:
 Ayame gains an extra jump (always valid for every switch).
 Kensei gains an extra defense point (damage reduction).
 Both characters gain 1 extra attack point.

LEVEL DESIGN

 Changed all levels to provide a smoother gameplay experience.
 Removed and rearranged sections in levels: Izumo Forest, Mount Dogo, Osaka, Kozuki Graveyard, Daisen Sanctuary.
 Removed some branching options in Daisen Cave.


The update is now available on all platforms! And, of course, this update is free for all.

Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of action platforming with Chronicles of 2 Heroes!

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Assist Mode is here!
notes.notes:
Hi heroes 👋

Chronicles of 2 Heroes is one month old! We have received loads of support during this time. And some constructive criticism, too. Thankfully, most of our player base values the tough challenge we offer. But there is a significant amount of people who struggle with some bosses and platforming segments. While we consider the game fair overall, we always wanted as many players as possible to enjoy it.

Consequently, in the spirit of games like Celeste, we have updated Chronicles of 2 Heroes with a brand-new assist mode. It provides the following benefits:


 Ayame becomes Kirby. The assist mode allows our kunoichi to jump endlessly while you keep pressing the jump button. She also regains five kunai every 30 seconds.
 Kensei got hands. Our samurai handles attacks better since the assist mode reduces all damage by half heart. Additionally, he deals double damage to ALL enemies, including bosses.
 Both heroes recover five hearts every 30 seconds while the mode is active.

[previewyoutube=hX5yO0tPpoI;full][/previewyoutube]
If you think it is broken, do not panic. Assist mode can be toggled on and off anytime by pressing the designated button. Feel free to activate it when you need extra health, a tad of help with tight jumps or an easier time with bosses. Ultimately, this is meant for you to enjoy our game as you please.

The patch is available now on Steam and will arrive on other platforms in the following days. We will announce its availability for each console on Twitter and Discord. Feel free to share your thoughts on this patch there, too!

See you in the next update.

- Israel, PR & CM.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Hello Heroes,

First thing first we want to thank all our supporters and reviewers! 

We would like to express our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and for taking the time to review our game. Your feedback has been invaluable to us, and we appreciate all the support we have received thus far. For those who haven't yet left a review, we kindly request you to do so, as it holds significant importance for us.

We have carefully listened to your feedback and addressed various issues and bugs that were reported. 

The following fixes have been implemented in this patch:

- Doors in Osaka level now unlock upon re visiting.
- The critical bug that prevented progress in the final section of Daisen Sanctuary has now been resolved.
- Map upgrades now save correctly and should be visible even in the temple after teleporting.
- "Piercing strike" doesn't unlock after beating Nobumasa.
- Fixed some achievements that weren't unlockable.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments.



We would also like to take this opportunity to share some exciting news. In the near future, we will be releasing a significant update that introduces a brand new accessibility feature. Stay tuned for more information and updates.

Thank you once again for your continued support. We greatly value your feedback and are committed to providing the best possible gaming experience. Stay connected with us for all the latest news and announcements.

Cheers
IE Team

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
We have just uploaded an updated demo which includes:

- Small changes to level design to make it more enjoyable and less tedious.
- Minor bug fixes.
- Changes to death zones, they no longer one-shot but instead return you to the beginning of the room.
- Changes to the save layout with updated time, collected collectibles, money, and more.
- Added a widget to cancel the dash.
- Added temples within the game.
- Added a map.

notes.title: 📺🗓️ New trailer + Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi heroes! 👋

This is the first proper update we post on Steam, and we're hyper-thrilled about it. Especially since we can share BIG NEWS with you 👀

Yesterday, we posted our release date trailer. Hope you like it! 👇

[previewyoutube=zH97phSAPJY;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s called a “release date trailer” for a reason. We can finally announce a digital release date: 

🔥 Chronicles of 2 Heroes will release on May 26! 🔥

That means the wait is almost over. Roughly two months, and you’ll enjoy our action platformer on Steam and every console. Shout-out to Catness Games for handling the porting! 😻

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282536/bba1beb5d5a3a9463a4751b9c00a70666bd8994b.png

Until the release date, don’t forget to try our free demo on Steam. Also, adding our game to your wishlist is extremely helpful ✨

Don't forget to follow us on Twitter and join our Discord server! 

See you in the next update! 🔜

notes.title: NEW DEMO AND CLOSED BETA UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here we are with some update on Chronicles of 2 Heroes! 

First things first, we are happy to announce that the kickstarter was a success and we really wanted to thank you for the support!

The team is hard at work to finish the development process, just a little more time and we will be able to release the game! As we are continuing our work on the project we did take some time to polish the demo and the closed beta! see below to have a little summary of the changes.  



DEMO UPDATE
- polished movement and controls
- new ranged AI behavior
- numerous bugfixes

EARLY ACCESS UPDATE
- various changes to levels (smoother experience)
- fixes of various minor bugs on some actors (stalactite, warrior ai, dialogue triggers)
- reworked texts
- added some visual clues when special doors are opened

As always if you find bugs or just want to share a feedback feel free to contact us in our discord server (https://discord.com/invite/KYGSDfUgSG) or on the Steam community page!

Thank you again for the support!
